The United States’ GDP per capita in 1850 was about $3,000 in 2011 PPP dollars, so the answer is B. Maddison’s figure of roughly $1,800 in 1990 international dollars rebases to about $3,000 using the 1990–2011 US price rise, and ~1.8% annual per-capita growth from that level reaches about $50,000 by 2011.

CONFIDENCE: 80
